root.label: Enumerations and unions
root.note: Enums are integers with fenced values; unions hold one live member at a time.

children.label: Scoped vs unscoped
children.note: enum class scopes its names and never converts implicitly.

children.label: Unscoped promotes
children.note: Unscoped enumerators leak into the enclosing scope and promote to int.

children.label: Underlying type
children.note: Scoped defaults to int; unscoped without : T uses an implementation-defined type.

children.label: std::to_underlying
children.note: C++23 shorthand for static_cast to std::underlying_type_t<E>.

children.label: Deprecated arithmetic
children.note: Enum-enum and enum-float arithmetic deprecated in C++20, removed in C++26.

children.label: Range of values
children.note: The set of values an enum may hold, defined in [dcl.enum].

children.label: Fixed underlying type
children.note: Every value of the underlying type is valid, enumerator or not.

children.label: No fixed type
children.note: Values of the smallest bit-field holding all enumerators, e.g. 0 to 7.

children.label: Out-of-range cast
children.note: Undefined since C++17 (CWG 1766); an unspecified value before.

children.label: Enum initialization
children.note: Ways to make an enum value without a cast.

children.label: Id i{42} (C++17)
children.note: Direct-list-init from an integer works only with a fixed underlying type.

children.label: Not = {42} or (42)
children.note: Copy-list-init and parentheses still need static_cast; narrowing is rejected.

children.label: using enum (C++20)
children.note: Brings a scoped enum's enumerators into namespace, class or block scope.

children.label: Active member
children.note: A union holds at most one live member; the language does not track which.

children.label: Inactive read is UB
children.note: It reads an object outside its lifetime; constant evaluation rejects it.

children.label: Switching members
children.note: Trivial assignment switches; non-trivial members need construct_at and destroy_at.

children.label: Common initial sequence
children.note: Standard-layout structs sharing a prefix may read it through either member.

children.label: No type punning
children.note: Valid C and a GCC extension, but UB in C++; use std::bit_cast.

children.label: Union restrictions
children.note: What a union may and may not contain or do.

children.label: No virtuals or bases
children.note: No virtual functions, no base classes, no reference members; never a base.

children.label: Non-trivial members
children.note: Delete the matching special members; write the constructor and destructor yourself.

children.label: One default initializer
children.note: At most one variant member may have a default member initializer.

children.label: Anonymous unions
children.note: Members join the enclosing scope; only public data members, static at namespace scope.

children.label: std::variant
children.note: A tagged union that constructs, destroys and checks the active alternative.

children.label: Checked access
children.note: std::get with the wrong alternative throws std::bad_variant_access.
